identification: Google DeepMind MuJoCo physics simulator Python source distribution, including the experimental Studio WebAssembly viewer.

comparison.provenance: PyPI exact-version metadata matches the supplied current SHA-256; prior sdist and all original prior wheels fetched with forager. Artifacts and .forage.json remain in scratch/version-drift-mujoco/previous.
comparison.decisive_diff: All firing alias, nested-call, numeric-return and fromCharCode fragments are unchanged at the same offsets. After normalizing generated import/export labels and ASM_CONST addresses, JavaScript changes add one invoke_jiii WASM-table wrapper and move an unchanged invoke_viiiiiiii wrapper. No new hidden source stage appears.
comparison.packaging: pyproject dependencies, optional dependencies and build backend are unchanged. setup.py adds _batch, removes the old Studio renderer extension and fixes a Windows path separator; __init__.py makes an existing sysctl command absolute and handles OSError. Viewer changes add hot reload/plugin support and replace 60 Hz state polling with event-driven wakeups.

execution_review: Startup determines browser/worker/Node environment, obtains the adjacent web_client.wasm via locateFile/readAsync, instantiates it, maps its imports/exports and calls _main.

Indexed aliases preserve canvas width/height; getUniform(program,webglGetUniformLocation(location)) obtains a WebGL uniform; EGL.setErrorCode(12288);return 62006 reports ordinary EGL values. Their same-line co-occurrence with UTF conversion is not a decoder loader.

String.fromCharCode serves UTF8/16/32 and Embind string conversion. Function constructors build typed Embind invocation wrappers; eval(UTF8ToString(ptr)) implements the Emscripten run_script_string bridge. These supported execution capabilities are retained.

HTTP retrieves the WASM/model/rendering assets. The C++ session and UI client derive /state and /ui WebSocket URLs from window.location.host; the Python server streams viewer state. SDL media, worker and virtual-filesystem helpers fit the runtime. No credential-to-send chain, persistence or unrelated payload activation was found.
